# Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role

| year          = 2003
| holder        = Deepika Singh for Mangal Lakshmi as Mangal Srivastava Saxena
| website       = [http://www.indiantellyawards.com Indian Telly Awards]
}}
Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role is an award given by the jury as a part of the annual Indian Telly Awards. It was awarded without prior nominations until 2012. Post that, the jury award has awarded with nominations like the popular award.
Winners
*2003Shweta Tiwari for Kasautii Zindagii Kay as Prerna Bajaj.
*2005Juhi Parmar for Kumkum – Ek Pyara Sa Bandhan as Kumkum Wadhwa.

*2008Not Awarded
